species.real: Cats seem to have tamed themselves around 10,000 years ago in the Near East, moving in on the first farmers' grain stores for the mice and staying for the laps.
species.name: Moggle

dex.text: A moggy of no fixed breed and very fixed opinions, out on the bins from dusk. Answers to the sound of a tin opening and nothing else.
dex.fact: The domestic cat and the European wildcat are close enough to interbreed, and decades of crossing with pet and feral cats have left few Scottish wildcats that are genetically pure.
